unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U04: Distinguish bailment possession,purpose and return from ownership or ordinary deposit

payload.title: Follow possession of identified goods
payload.core_explanation_md:
Bailment concerns delivery of goods for a purpose with the agreed return or disposal when that purpose is fulfilled. Possession may be actual or constructively established; ownership does not pass merely because the recipient holds the goods. A person already possessing them can enter the described bailment relationship without an unnecessary physical round trip.

Distinguish this from an ordinary bank money deposit, which is a debt relationship rather than an obligation to return the same notes. A custody receipt alone should not be used to infer every condition:identify the goods, control, purpose and return directions. Finder or court-custody situations need their own legal basis and are not resolved by a blanket writing requirement.

self_check.prompt_text: Does transfer of possession necessarily transfer ownership?

payload.stem_md: A custodian holds identified items for a stated purpose and agreed return. A clerk labels that holding an outright sale solely because possession changed. What is missing?

options.text_md: The distinction between possession and transfer of ownership
options.explanation_md: Bailment can transfer possession while ownership remains elsewhere.
It does not decide the legal relationship.

options.text_md: A rule that every custody arrangement is a loan
options.explanation_md: Goods custody and money lending differ.

options.text_md: The assumption that every oral arrangement is void
options.explanation_md: The source does not impose universal writing.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Bailment can transfer possession while ownership remains elsewhere.

payload.stem_md: Goods are already held by a person who now agrees to hold them as bailee. Must the goods physically leave and re-enter solely to create the described relationship?

options.text_md: Always, because constructive delivery is impossible
Not necessarily; the existing-possession explanation can apply
options.explanation_md: The legal agreement can change the capacity of holding.
Holding capacity is not ownership transfer.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The legal agreement can change the capacity of holding.
